meta.title: Custom grouping instruction typed into the chat input

args.goal: with the Smart Grouping side panel open, type a custom grouping rule into the chat input, click the blue send icon, and stop when the panel shows an AI response containing grouping logic and the conditions being applied

steps.note: Performs the chat interaction and verifies the response content on the buyer's screen.
Confirms the panel remains rendered without an error or crash after processing the request.
